title: Cold Cucumber Miso Soup (Kyūri no hiyajiru) - Okonomi Kitchen
ldName: Cold Cucumber Miso Soup (Kyūri no hiyajiru)
ldKeywords: cucumber, miso soup, cold miso soup, cold soup
ldInstructionsRaw: Thinly slice the cucumbers into rounds. Thinly slice the shiso leaves and myoga. Massage in 1 tbsp of miso paste and set aside for 3 minutes.
Add the shiso, myoga and ground sesame, and mix well.
Whisk in the dashi broth. Chill for 10-15 minutes and then serve with ice.
